top3suspects.name: Chip Patina
top3suspects.reason: The toxin is a missing conservation reference sample, giving Chip the clearest apparent access to the means. Grant threatened his work and career. No opportunity at the coupe has yet been established.

top3suspects.name: Artie Ficial
top3suspects.reason: The donor agreement would strip him of his museum and job. That is a dramatic, immediate motive, though we have no movement evidence tying him to the private coupe.

top3suspects.name: Mona Lott
top3suspects.reason: Grant's permanent holding announcement could destroy restitution negotiations; the warning about returning what was taken fits that dispute. The fit is thematic, not proof of authorship or poisoning.

overallConfidence: Low: motives are widespread, and the useful distinction will be access to the coupe between delivery and service. The clean decanter excludes a general cordial poisoning.
